title: Riverbend Patient Financial Services Policy: Patient Payment Plan Tier Assignment and Schedule Terms
content:
**1. Tier by balance.** The tier of a new **Patient Payment Plan** is fixed by the total balance enrolled at creation, using each tier's minimum and maximum enrolled balance.

**2. Override tiers.** Two tiers override the balance bands.
- The **Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan** applies when, on the creation date, the patient holds a financial assistance award in approved status at a partial-discount tier (80%, 60% or 40% charity discount, or medical hardship). The award is established from Riverbend's financial assistance records for that same patient, as they stand on the creation date, before the plan is created.
- The **Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan** applies when the patient documents a loss of household income of at least the tier's hardship income-loss percentage in the last 6 months, or when the enrolled total exceeds the tier's hardship balance threshold.
- When both override tiers apply, the hardship tier is used.

**3. Down payment at creation.** The clause "The down payment is the down payment percentage of the enrolled total, rounded half-up to the cent, due at signing" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**4. Term.** The clause "The term is the number of monthly installments the patient asks for, never more than the maximum term; when the patient states no term, the maximum term is used" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**5. Installment.** The clause "The installment is the financed amount (enrolled total less the down payment) divided by the term, rounded half-up to the cent, but never below the minimum monthly payment; when the floor applies, the schedule has as many installments as the floor needs, and in every case the final installment absorbs the remainder" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**6. Due dates.** Installments fall due on the due day the patient picks from the tier's due day options; the first due date is the first such day at least the tier's first-due gap of calendar days after the signing date.

**7. No charges.** Riverbend plans carry no interest, setup fee, late fee, returned-payment fee or early-payoff penalty (the tier's interest rate, setup fee, late fee, returned-payment fee and early-payoff penalty).

**8. Autopay.** Where the tier requires autopay, the plan is created only with an ACH or card autopay method.

### Override tiers at a glance (clause 2)

| Assistance award condition met on the creation date | Hardship condition met | Tier used |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan |
| No | Yes | Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan |
| Yes | Yes | Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan |
| No | No | the tier whose balance band holds the enrolled total |

### First due date (clause 6), hypothetical

A patient who signs on the 3rd of a month, picks the 15th as due day, on a tier whose first-due gap is 25 days: the 15th of the same month is 12 days away and the 15th of the next month is 40 or more days away, so the first due date is the 15th of the next month, the first such day at least 25 calendar days after signing.

superseded_clauses: The down payment is down_payment_pct of the enrolled total, rounded half-up to the cent, due at signing.
The term is the number of monthly installments the patient asks for, never more than max_term_months; when the patient states no term, max_term_months is used.

The installment is the financed amount (enrolled total less the down payment) divided by the term, rounded half-up to the cent, but never below min_monthly_payment_usd; when the floor applies, the schedule has as many installments as the floor needs, and in every case the final installment absorbs the remainder.
